latest.title: New Homogeneous Einstein Metrics from Detection
latest.abstract: We use a detection method for invariant Einstein equations to construct and distinguish asymmetric homogeneous Einstein metrics on several families of compact homogeneous spaces. The method retains a geometrically meaningful symmetry-breaking parameter, eliminates the remaining Einstein equations, and then reconstructs positive metrics from the resulting detector. We prove a sharp threshold in a two-factor symplectic family, construct two asymmetric Einstein metrics on each admissible space $\SU(n)^3/Δ\SO(n)$, obtain a sharp threshold for $\SU(2n)^3/Δ\Sp(n)$, and construct asymmetric metrics on three exceptional three-factor families. The four-factor case exhibits a further phenomenon. On \[ M_9=\SU(18)^4/Δ\Sp(9) \] the two symmetry types $3+1$ and $2+2$ are both realized: up to homothety and internal block permutations, the corresponding fixed families contain exactly three asymmetric Einstein metrics, two with three equal horizontal scales and one distinct scale (type $3+1$), and one with two equal pairs of horizontal scales (type $2+2$). They are pairwise non-isometric, Riemannian irreducible, and not naturally reductive. The $2+2$ metric is globally unique in the full positive $2+2$ fixed family up to block interchange.
latest.workSummary: 用“检测器”消元方法在多族紧齐性空间上构造并区分非对称 Einstein 度量，得到若干尖锐存在阈值及四因子空间上的 3+1 与 2+2 两种对称破缺类型。
latest.breakthrough: 不仅给出新度量，还在 SU(18)^4/ΔSp(9) 的固定族中精确得到三个两两非等距、不可约且非自然约化的非对称 Einstein 度量。
latest.limitations: 构造局限于列出的齐性空间与固定对称族；检测器的全局完备性依赖逐族代数证书。
latest.aiEvidence: 作者使用 ChatGPT 协助表述、组织、制图、校对以及论证呈现/检查建议，并独立验证所有贡献。
latest.priorityReason: 显式扩展齐性 Einstein 度量图谱，检测器兼具构造和唯一性判别能力。
